texts.name: Design the complete FinX mobile app for Alex Morgan: a banking area (sign up, verify identity, see cards, exchange rates, transactions, budget and profile) and an XTrade trading area (portfolio, crypto market, stock and crypto exchange). Canvas 390 × 844, iPhone. Work in your own new Figma file — this file is read-only reference.
texts.text:
Design the complete FinX mobile app for Alex Morgan: a banking area (sign up, verify identity, see cards, exchange rates, transactions, budget and profile) and an XTrade trading area (portfolio, crypto market, stock and crypto exchange).
Canvas 390 × 844, iPhone. Work in your own new Figma file — this file is read-only reference.

texts.name: 1. Build exactly the 10 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links. 2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions. 3. The brand primary color and the typefaces in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself (neutrals, text, surfaces, light / dark mode, gain / loss, success / error / warning / disabled, chart colors), plus type scale, spacing, radii and elevation, and apply them consistently. 4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button, a default Text Field and the platform shell (status bar, home indicator). Design all other states, the headers, both bottom navigations and every business component as reusable components in your file. 5. Use logos, coin icons, banners, the avatar, the ID card placeholder and icons from 04 · Media. 6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
texts.text:
1. Build exactly the 10 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links.
2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions.
3. The brand primary color and the typefaces in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself (neutrals, text, surfaces, light / dark mode, gain / loss, success / error / warning / disabled, chart colors), plus type scale, spacing, radii and elevation, and apply them consistently.
4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button, a default Text Field and the platform shell (status bar, home indicator). Design all other states, the headers, both bottom navigations and every business component as reusable components in your file.
5. Use logos, coin icons, banners, the avatar, the ID card placeholder and icons from 04 · Media.
6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
